sections.title: Where You Live
sections.content: 'Vivir' is the -ir verb you saw conjugated last lesson, and now you need it for real. It is completely regular. It takes 'en' for the place — 'vivo en Hanói', 'vivimos en un apartamento' — never 'a'. To say what is nearby, use 'cerca de', which behaves exactly like 'al lado de' from Lesson 4.

items.spanish: Vivimos en un apartamento pequeño, pero muy luminoso.
items.english: We live in a small apartment, but a very bright one.

items.spanish: El apartamento está cerca del trabajo.
Además, tenemos una vista muy bonita.
items.english: What's more, we have a very pretty view.

sections.content: 'Cerca de' contracts in front of 'el', the same way 'al lado de' does: 'cerca del trabajo', never 'cerca de el trabajo'.
